title: Glowing magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lens' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#eafffb'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#7bf7e4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#20c7b0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handle' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd166'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8862a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow halo -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='32' fill='#3fe8d0' opacity='0.25'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='26' fill='#3fe8d0' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- lens glass -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='21' fill='url(#lens)'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#bffdf2' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- shine -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='32' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-25 35 32)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- rim -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='23' fill='none' stroke='#ff9f4d' stroke-width='5'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='23' fill='none' stroke='#ffd9a8' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='58' y='57' width='11' height='30' rx='5' fill='url(#handle)' transform='rotate(-45 63 62)'/>
  <rect x='58' y='57' width='11' height='30' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#fff0c9' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.8' transform='rotate(-45 63 62)'/>
</svg>
